## PartMotion  (type-only)
type PartMotion = {
    type: 'spin';

    pivot?: PartVec3;
    channel: string;
    ratio?: number;
} | {
    type: 'swing';

    pivot?: PartVec3;

    phase?: number;
} | {
    type: 'hinge';
    axis: PartAxis;

    channel: string;
    from: number;
    to: number;
} | {
    type: 'slide';
    axis: PartAxis;
    channel: string;

    to: number;
} | {
    type: 'bob';

};
